page.layout: One printed page of text in the centre; a narrow strip of marginal notes and text from a neighbouring page at the left edge (partly cut off, not transcribed as notes). Running head at top: "De Sacra Scriptura" with chapter label "Cap. III." and page number 65 at top right. Main text in one column, with paragraphs and a few side marginal notes visible only as fragments at the left edge, which belong to the adjacent page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: rigendi, sive disciplina justitiæ inculcanda. Quin etiàm (*.) totum negotium conficit, & planè hanc litem terminat; concludens: ut Vir Dei (h. e. Doctor Ecclesiæ ex ordinatione Dei; ꝥ Reg. xvii, 24. 1 Tim. vi, 11.) perfectus fit, in omnibus videl. istis partibus; & breviter ad omne opus bonum perfectè instructus. Ex perfectione effectûs patet perfectio causæ.

2. Locis quibusdam V. T. Exod. xxiv, 3, 4. „Venit ergo Moseh, & narravit populo omnia Verba Iehovæ, omniaque judicia: & respondit totus populus voce unâ, ac dixerunt; Omnia Verba, quæ locutus est „Jehovah, faciemus. Et scripsit Moseh omnia verba Iehovæ. Moses, quæ à Deo audivit, omnia populo narravit; eademque omnia scripto confignavit: ne ea oblivioni traderentur, imò ut etiàm posterorum usibus servirent; cum quibus Deus idem fœdus pepigit. Exod. xxiv, 27. Deut. xxix, 14, 15. xxxi, 9, 21.

Iterùm Deut. xxxi, 24, -27. „Cùm autem finem fecisset Moseh scribendi verba Legis istius in libro, donec ea complerentur: Præcepit Moseh Levitis portantibus arcam fœderis Jehovæ dicendo; Capite librum istum, &c. Vide sup. th. 28. Legis ergò scripturam absolvit Moses; omnesque ejus partes complevit: & pro posteris exemplar illud, tanquàm depositum ac testimonium, diligentissimè conservandum mandavit. Ita quidem ut nemini quicquam addere, vel detrahere liceret; sed præscriptum illud accuratissimè omnes sequi deberent, non recedendo dextrorsùm vel sinistrorsùm; Deut. iv, 1, 2. v, 38, 39. xii, 32. Iof.1,7. xxiii, 6. Prov. xxx, 5, 6.
Insigne etiam est testimonium Psal. xix, 8, 9. Vide sup. th. 22. Ubi diserte perfectio laudatur, & quidem ad convertendam animam, sapientiam efficiendam, cor lætificandum, &c.
3. Similia sunt testimonia N. T. Luc. xvi, 29. ubi de evitandâ condemnatione: Habent Mosen & Prophetas;

page.notes: Marginal strip at left edge is largely cut off and belongs to the facing page; fragments such as "illu-", "ciens", "gell." were not transcribed. Several words in the text are uncertain due to fading and show-through, notably the Greek/symbol mark "(*.)" and the signature/catchword area at the foot, which is blank apart from a faint "E" and "tát" at the bottom right.
